summary.text: John Burke is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 9 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
He works in information technology and has served in the Senate since January 5, 2021, succeeding Adam Satchell.

paragraphs.text: John Burke lives in West Warwick, Rhode Island, and graduated from Bishop Hendricken High School in 1978.
He earned a degree in computer science from the Community College of Rhode Island.
His career experience includes working as a computer operator with Puritan Life Insurance and in various IT positions with the University of Rhode Island.
Burke assumed office in the Rhode Island State Senate on January 5, 2021, and his current term ends on January 5, 2027.
For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists him on the Senate Judiciary Committee, the Housing and Municipal Government Committee and the Senate Labor Committee.
